name: Intercession Of Saints
overview: Scripture reveals that intercession is a vital aspect of the believer's relationship with God, demonstrated by both human and divine advocates. Job's role as an intercessor in Job 42:8 shows that God accepts the prayers of the righteous on behalf of others. The New Testament emphasizes Christ's unique and eternal intercession for believers at God's right hand (Romans 8:34; Hebrews 7:25), while also encouraging Christians to pray fervently for one another (Romans 15:30; Ephesians 6:18). Additionally, believers are surrounded by a 'great cloud of witnesses' who inspire perseverance in faith, though the text does not attribute intercessory roles to them (Hebrews 12:1).
